headline: Turns out you can just rewrite model weights
summary: The real new stuff today: you can mess with a model's insides without training it; plus a whole small-model family went open source all at once.

items.title: Astra reads and writes model weights directly
items.pitch: For the first time a model can edit its own internal weights like a doc, no retraining. Sounds scary, but it's the most "new species" move of the year.
why: #1 on the HN front page, 2755 points, 837 comments, hottest all day
Rewrites Qwen's weights directly to boost ability, skipping training
You know Claude Code, which edits code; this edits the model itself
actions: Open the demo page below, you'll get the idea in 5 minutes, nothing to install
Don't rush to reproduce it locally, waiting for the community's wrapper tools is easier
deep_dive: Unlike Claude Code editing code, this tunes the model's internal parameters (weights) directly so it grows abilities it didn't have.
It runs on open models like Qwen; for now the author only shipped a demo, no one-click install.
Honestly: it's still a research toy and hard for non-devs to use; but the direction is worth watching more than any benchmark.
items.signals: HN 2755 points · 837 comments · Latent Space top story of the day · garrytan and swyx are both sharing it

items.title: LiquidAI open-sources the whole LFM3 family at once
items.pitch: Dropped five small models in a few hours—text, vision, audio, full multimodal—that run on your own computer, and even fit on a phone.
why: LFM3-1.7B hit 47k downloads and 1310 likes in a few hours
GGUF and MLX versions are both there, a few clicks on a Mac and it's installed
2B class, runs offline on a laptop, no API calls needed
actions: Search LFM3-1.7B-GGUF in LM Studio, download it and just start chatting
Try it on local doc summaries—free, and your data never leaves
deep_dive: No conflict with the Claude Code you use every day: this is a pocket-sized model that works offline.
A notch below the big models in skill, but it wins on free, private, and fast.
Good for jobs you can't upload, like sensitive salary files.
items.signals: Five models on the HF trending list at once · LFM3-1.7B 47k downloads · GGUF version 194k downloads

items.title: Revolut moves its models back to its own servers
items.pitch: A fintech is ditching cloud APIs to self-host the open model GLM. That's the wind for enterprise AI buying.
why: HN 105 points, 70 comments, everyone's doing the math on cost
Big companies fear data leaving, so self-hosting went from niche to an option

still_tracking.update: Simon Willison confirms OpenAI launched the same thing: $100/$200/$500 subscriptions come with matching API credits
